FEM Lab STEP converter: occt-import-js-0.0.23+femlab.1

This standalone converter uses and is based on facilities provided by Open CASCADE
Technology software. It contains occt-import-js wrapper source at
c2148e54b456b571238d35cac037d304053d64b2 and Open CASCADE Technology 7.6.1 at
d2abb6d844231cb8f29be6894440874a4700e4a5. Both are distributed under LGPL 2.1;
OCCT additionally grants the exception in licenses/OCCT_LGPL_EXCEPTION.txt.

Copyright and license notices in the full source trees are preserved in the
complete corresponding-source.tar.gz, distributed alongside the converter.
Full LGPL texts are supplied separately for the wrapper and OCCT in licenses/.
The OCCT exception permits specified header-derived object code; it is not
treated as a blanket exception for linking the kernel into this executable.

FEM Lab modifications dated 2026-10-15:
1. Reject transfer warnings/failures, omitted recognized roots, unsupported free topology,
   incomplete meshing and missing face/output geometry; return structured failure
   and a versioned completeness receipt; enforce input/triangle ceilings. Face
   counts describe post-transfer TopoDS occurrences, not all original STEP entities.
2. Emit a modular ES-module entry for independently replaceable Worker/Node use.

These converter modifications are distributed under LGPL 2.1. The separate FEM
engine/application remains under its own license. No warranty is provided; see
the included license texts. The public JS receipt/arrays are the replacement
interface. Complete sources, patches, build recipe and replacement instructions
are included in the accompanying source kit and vendor README.
The separate FEM Lab build/source-packaging recipes are under the repository's
MIT license, reproduced in licenses/FEM-Lab-MIT.txt with its copyright notice.

Generated JavaScript glue and linked C/C++ runtime facilities come from Emscripten
3.1.69 at c55ff404dbe1eb9f263c48b584d5ba627224763a. The full Emscripten preferred
source is included in the source kit. Its LICENSE includes Emscripten MIT/NCSA
and Node-derived path-library notices; additional musl, LLVM compiler-rt,
libc++, libc++abi and libunwind license/copyright texts are supplied in licenses/.
